strategyName: Texas TREC Active Broker or Sales Agent Roster Lookup Strategy

bulkRosterSource.publisher: Texas Real Estate Commission (TREC Public Information)
bulkRosterSource.sourceAssessment: Authoritative statewide bulk source with exact license status and expiration dates. The 326,020 rows include active records and non-active/historical statuses; use exact status and license_type rather than treating every row as a current licensee. Strict Active counts are 188,538 (13,833 companies, 33,533 individual brokers, 141,172 sales agents); additional active-probation statuses total 243 records.

captureResult.snapshotReviewStatus: Reviewed for internal firm-campaign research only; outreach and account matching remain unapproved
captureResult.reasonForReview: TREC identifies the files as High Value Data Sets and publishes bulk import/filter instructions. The reviewed pages do not specifically authorize solicitation or account matching. Keep direct outreach, account matching, and application import blocked pending separate compliance review.

bulkRosterSource.ingestionRecommendation: Prefer this bulk dataset over crawling 18,630 paginated search result pages. Keep company, individual broker, and sales-agent records distinct, preserve exact status and expiration, and confirm dataset-use terms before campaign use.

deferredFollowUp.status: Official-source data-use review completed; outreach/account-matching review remains open
researchItems: Before outbound solicitation or account matching, obtain separate compliance review; the public-data designation and bulk-use instructions are not treated as campaign-solicitation authorization.

Inspect the 116 current-status rows omitted from the application capture because the source and related-license records did not provide one unambiguous name; decide whether they should remain omitted or be represented as unnamed entity/license records.
Confirm whether active-probation statuses belong in the current operational roster or should be classified separately.
deferredFollowUp.campaignUse: The 20-record Broker Company sample may be used as an internal campaign-research lead list only. Do not use the roster as a contact source, conduct outbound solicitation, or account-match until separately cleared.

importantTaxonomyNote: TREC's Broker or Sales Agent filter is combined. Classify each returned record from its exact License Type/detail profile; do not treat the query category as broker-only.

detailProfile.ceSummary: TREC detail states 18 hours CE per license period, including 4-hour Legal Update I, 4-hour Legal Update II, 3-hour contract-related coursework, and when applicable 6-hour Broker Responsibility.

entityRule: Business Broker records are entity candidates; Individual Broker and Sales Agent records are individual licensees. Active firms and their related active personnel should be retained for campaigns; inactive records belong in historical storage.
renewalReminderRule: Texas reminders must use the exact license type and expiration date. Sales agents have person-specific CE/sponsorship reminders; business broker records identify the firm and designated broker, not a person course recipient.
note: Earlier UI research sampled the first result page and entity profiles. Subsequent review found the official statewide bulk dataset above; no all-page UI crawl was performed.
